title: How a web page reaches you
desc: Type an address and a few things happen in about a tenth of a second. Follow the numbers from top to bottom.

bands.label: You
bands.remark: Your browser knows only the name of the site, like shop.com.

cards.name: Your browser
cards.text: You type a web address and press Enter.

bands.label: Finding the address
bands.remark: Names are for people. Computers need numbers, so this lookup comes first.

cards.name: DNS
cards.text: Turns the name into a number, the IP address.

bands.label: The edge
bands.remark: Fast path: with a copy at the CDN, the trip ends at step 3.

cards.name: CDN
cards.text: A copy near you. If it has the page, it answers here.

cards.name: Load balancer
cards.text: Otherwise it picks a server that is not busy.

cards.name: Web server
cards.text: Builds the page from the pieces it needs.

cards.name: Cache
cards.text: Remembers recent answers so it can skip the database.

bands.label: The data
bands.remark: The answer travels back the same way, and the browser draws the page.

cards.name: Database
cards.text: Holds the real information: products, accounts, orders.
